title: Split ChatToolCatalog.BuildTools (~900 lines) into per-domain partial class files
description:
ChatToolCatalog.cs is ~1,600 lines and its BuildTools method (~900 lines) defines all 22 tool descriptors inline, making review and merge painful (it was a conflict hotspot in PR #53/#54).

### Approach
- Make ChatToolCatalog a partial class; keep catalog plumbing (ctor, TryGet, McpTools/ChatTools/AgentTools views, ToolJsonOptions) in ChatToolCatalog.cs
- Move descriptor construction into per-domain partials, e.g. ChatToolCatalog.SearchTools.cs (search/fetch/context pack), ChatToolCatalog.PageTools.cs, ChatToolCatalog.TaskTools.cs, ChatToolCatalog.MemoryWriteTools.cs, ChatToolCatalog.CodeSearchTools.cs, ChatToolCatalog.SourceTools.cs
- BuildTools becomes a concatenation of per-domain builder methods; no behavior change

### Acceptance criteria
- ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests pass unchanged (22 tools, same names/risks/availability flags)
- No file exceeds ~400 lines
- git blame-friendly: pure moves, no descriptor edits in the same commit
